description: This file defines the Wayland display and surface management classes within the Thunder::Wayland namespace, including surface creation, reference counting, EGL integration, and input handling. It contains class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures for managing Wayland surfaces and display state.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display
classes.description: Represents a Wayland display, managing surfaces, input, EGL context, and display state.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for display event callbacks, such as surface attachment and detachment.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::Surface
classes.description: Wrapper for a Wayland surface, providing methods for manipulation and reference counting.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::Image
classes.description: Represents an EGL image associated with the display, with reference counting.

classes.name: Thunder::Wayland::Display::IProcess
classes.description: Interface for processing loop execution within the display.

methods.name: Display()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display object.

methods.name: Instance(const std::string& displayName)
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the display for the given name.

methods.name: ~Display()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments reference count for the display object.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes if zero.

methods.name: Native()
methods.description: Returns the native EGL display handle.

methods.name: Create(const std::string& name, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, ISurface::ICallback* callback)
methods.description: Creates a new surface with specified parameters.

methods.name: SurfaceByName(const std::string& name)
methods.description: Retrieves a surface by its name.

methods.name: Physical()
methods.description: Returns physical display dimensions.

methods.name: FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the display connection.

methods.name: Process(const uint32_t data)
methods.description: Runs the display processing loop.

methods.name: Callback(ICallback* callback)
methods.description: Sets the callback interface for display events.

methods.name: GetDisplay()
methods.description: Returns the EGL display handle.

methods.name: Trigger()
methods.description: Posts the trigger semaphore.

methods.name: WaitForTrigger()
methods.description: Waits on the trigger semaphore.

methods.name: Redraw()
methods.description: Posts the redraw semaphore.

methods.name: WaitForRedraw()
methods.description: Waits on the redraw semaphore.

methods.name: Constructed(uint32_t id, wl_surface* surface)
methods.description: Handles construction of a surface with a wl_surface pointer.

methods.name: Destructed(uint32_t id)
methods.description: Handles destruction of a surface by id.

methods.name: Dimensions(uint32_t id, uint32_t visible, int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t width, int32_t height, uint32_t opacity, uint32_t zorder)
methods.description: Updates surface dimensions and properties.

methods.name: FocusKeyboard(struct wl_surface* surface, bool state)
methods.description: Sets focus for keyboard input on a surface.

methods.name: FocusPointer(struct wl_surface* surface, bool state)
methods.description: Sets focus for pointer input on a surface.

methods.name: KeyMapConfiguration(const char information[], uint16_t size)
methods.description: Updates keymap configuration for all surfaces.

methods.name: Key(uint32_t key, IKeyboard::state action, uint32_t)
methods.description: Handles keyboard key events.

methods.name: Modifiers(uint32_t depressedMods, uint32_t latchedMods, uint32_t lockedMods, uint32_t group)
methods.description: Handles modifier key state changes.

methods.name: Repeat(int32_t rate, int32_t delay)
methods.description: Sets keyboard repeat rate and delay.

methods.name: SendPointerPosition(uint16_t x, uint16_t y)
methods.description: Sends pointer position events.

methods.name: SendPointerButton(uint8_t button, IPointer::state action)
methods.description: Sends pointer button events.
